end.summary:
Practised the levels of organisation from cell to organism.
Used human and plant examples at each level.
Yash identified the order as cell → tissue → organ → organ system → organism.
Clarified that the heart is one organ, while the circulatory system is an organ system.
Teach-back was not passed; the final explanation included why tissues form organs and why an organism is the whole living thing.
end.parentNote: Asha practised arranging the levels and linking each level to examples. Yash worked through the mix-up between the heart and the circulatory system, and corrected it later by identifying the heart as an organ and the circulatory system as an organ system. At home, ask them to arrange the five levels and give one human and one plant example for each.
